This space explores system design through an agnostic lens, grounded in patterns from 80+ systems built and evolved, a structured consolidation of methods and ongoing inquiry, and a set of cross-domain heuristics for building resilient systems

Exploring system design, structured consolidation, and cross-domain heuristics for resilient systems

System Patterns Atlas

An opinionated collection of system design patterns observed across large-scale platforms, annotated with trade-offs, failure modes, and real deployment constraints. Includes diagrams, notes, and evolving commentary rather than polished templates.

Structured Consolidation: A Working Paper

A long-form working paper that documents how disparate system design ideas were progressively consolidated into a smaller, reusable set of principles. Focuses on synthesis, not prescription.

A set of loosely structured case notes drawn from production systems that experienced partial failure. Each entry focuses on what broke, what held, and which assumptions turned out to be incorrect.
